definition: point_in_time_vintage_certified=true iff a pit-vintage-certification-v1 receipt binds the capture_id, every lane manifest sha256 and this contract's content sha256; every source of the 131 features, the label and the universe has a level in {V,O,R,I,N/A}; this contract is approved; and T1, T2, T4, T5 passed. It does not prove original publication timestamps for 2020-05..2026-05 (Q1 hybrid).

levels.V: vendor vintage guaranteed and spot-checked unchanged
levels.O: first seen in our own archived capture (observed_at)
levels.R: conservative lag rule with measured same-day availability and revision rate under the thresholds
levels.I: revision cannot change the model input (math property plus test)
levels.N/A: not an input of the 7 main models (E5)
levels.U: none of the above; certification fails

session_calendar: capture price sessions (training_calendar.json / stock price rows); never KV holiday:*
lag_semantics: lag_sessions n: a value whose availability date is d lands on the stock's first price row dated on or after d (d's own row when d is a session of that stock) and is first used n price rows of the same stock later; n = 0 uses that first row. Applied in ml-service build_feature_matrix only when the payload carries pit_contract_version equal to contract_version; without it serving output is unchanged. Sessions are the stock's own price rows, not a market calendar: a suspension only delays a value, never makes it earlier. Availability-dated history (per_stock_ts) joins backward as of each price row; margin/short rows from chips join on their exact date, so a chip row dated on a day the stock has no price row is dropped, not moved. The same margin/short values also reach per_stock_ts history, where a value dated on a non-price day lands on the next price row and then takes its lag, so that path is later, never earlier. Under a version the feature layer also refuses same-day serving scalars for lagged fields and computes the avg_price (VWAP) and volumeMomentumDivergence fallbacks per row; batch_prediction refuses a versioned serving request without per_stock_ts (pit_lagged_history_missing). A version's feature_lags are frozen in ml-service pit_contract._FEATURE_LAGS_SHA256; changing them needs a new contract version.

Serving: an artifact whose training input_scope records pit_contract_version must be served with the same version and with per_stock_ts history for lagged fields; batch_prediction refuses a mismatch (pit_contract_version_serving_mismatch). Forwarding the version from the Worker and daily inference prep is promotion work outside Phase 1.
The Cloud Run ml-service image does not copy data/feature_registry; a request with pit_contract_version there fails closed (pit_contract_missing). The Modal image mounts it.
eps revisions published after the S1027 vintage are not in pit_eps_revision_mask_v1; a later restatement is masked only after a new mask version is measured and approved.

Receipts are not signed. ml-controller re-derives the flag from the recorded evidence, test results and file sha256 values that the local CLI wrote; whoever runs the CLI and uploads the receipt is trusted for those inputs.
